title: Detailed envelope
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- envelope body -->
  <rect x='14' y='28' width='72' height='48' rx='3' fill='#f5c842' stroke='#c99a1a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- inner shadow / opening -->
  <rect x='16' y='30' width='68' height='44' rx='2' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- top flap -->
  <path d='M14 30 L50 56 L86 30' fill='#e6a817' stroke='#c99a1a' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- flap inner highlight -->
  <path d='M18 31 L50 54 L82 31' fill='#f2b830'/>
  <!-- bottom fold lines -->
  <line x1='14' y1='72' x2='38' y2='52' stroke='#c99a1a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='86' y1='72' x2='62' y2='52' stroke='#c99a1a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- side fold shades -->
  <path d='M14 30 L38 50 L14 72 Z' fill='#f0b81e' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M86 30 L62 50 L86 72 Z' fill='#f0b81e' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- wax seal -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='9' fill='#e8442a' stroke='#b82d18' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='6' fill='#ff6644'/>
  <!-- seal shine -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='54' r='2' fill='#ffaa88' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- stamp area top right -->
  <rect x='68' y='34' width='14' height='12' rx='1' fill='#7dd4f0' stroke='#4aa8c8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- stamp perforations -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='34' r='1' fill='#4aa8c8'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='34' r='1' fill='#4aa8c8'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='46' r='1' fill='#4aa8c8'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='46' r='1' fill='#4aa8c8'/>
  <!-- stamp design (small house) -->
  <rect x='72' y='40' width='6' height='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M71 40 L75 37 L79 40 Z' fill='#e8442a'/>
  <!-- address lines -->
  <line x1='38' y1='64' x2='70' y2='64' stroke='#c99a1a' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.5'/>
  <line x1='42' y1='68' x2='66' y2='68' stroke='#c99a1a' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
